title: The Fallows' actual central grief (named 'the Long Furrow' in the epilogue) was never reachable through any room or NPC found around Wickstead/Barrowmere, despite the region overview promising every hold's grief can be rested/bargained/burned and an active 'Names for the Rite' quest pointing at 'the headland's markers.' The ending itself confirms it: 'The Long Furrow still lies open south of Wickstead, unrested, unbargained, unburned, exactly as the winter left it.'
where: The Fallows / Wickstead (grief location never found)
